operations.deletionDescription: This marks the account as deleted. It does not physically erase the customer or historical records. The account can be restored where the server permits it.
operations.restorationDescription: This restores the account's active state. Restoration can be refused if its account details conflict with another active account.
operations.conversionTitle: Create an order from this reservation?
operations.conversionDescription: Confirm conversion of this processing reservation. The order total and the order and reservation statuses will be supplied after creation.
operations.completionTitle: Select and complete this initiative order?
operations.completionDescription: This selects the pending initiative order as completed and cancels the other orders for the same unit. Review the reference carefully. The server checks eligibility and any existing winner before committing.
operations.completionEligibility: Only pending initiative orders can be completed. Current eligibility and any competing selection are checked before the action is accepted.
operations.deletionSaved: The customer was marked as soft-deleted and current data was reloaded.
operations.restorationSaved: The customer was restored and current data was reloaded.
operations.conversionSaved: The order and reservation were reloaded. Open the linked order to review the server's total and status.
operations.completionSaved: The current order status was reloaded. Related order views will refresh to show the server's result.
operations.deletionConflict: The customer state changed or deletion is unavailable. Current data was checked; review it before continuing.
operations.restorationConflict: Restoration was refused, possibly because account details are already in use. Current data was checked; no automatic retry was sent.
operations.conversionConflict: The reservation may already have an order, its status may have changed, or the unit may be unavailable. Current data was checked without repeating conversion.
operations.completionConflict: This order may no longer be pending, may not be an initiative order, or another order may already be selected. Current data was checked without repeating completion.
operations.deletionUncertain: We could not confirm the deletion outcome or its follow-up read. The customer may already be soft-deleted. Check current data before another action.
operations.restorationUncertain: We could not confirm restoration or its follow-up read. The account may already be restored. Check current data before another action.
operations.conversionUncertain: We could not confirm conversion or its follow-up reads. An order may already exist. Check the current reservation and linked order before another action; do not repeat conversion blindly.
operations.completionUncertain: We could not confirm completion or its follow-up read. This order may already be selected and competing orders changed. Check current data before another action.

catalogue: Manage the active catalogue, its relationships, amenities and images.
parentUnavailable: The selected parent could not be loaded. Check the relationship before saving.
formHint: Save submits every editable field. Blank optional fields are sent as null. Names and descriptions are stored as supplied.
nullable: Optional. Leave blank for no value.
dateHint: Optional for regular projects; required for initiatives. Use an ISO timestamp with timezone, for example 2026-12-01T12:00:00Z.
invalid: Enter a valid value within the allowed range. Check required fields and the selected project type.
saved: Saved and current catalogue data reloaded.
conflict: The catalogue changed or this action is blocked by its relationships. Current data was reloaded where possible. Your draft is preserved; review it before submitting again.
uncertain: The write outcome or its follow-up read could not be confirmed. Your draft is preserved. Check current data before another action; do not repeat a create or upload without checking the list.
deleteHint: Delete this record? This removes its current catalogue entry and discards edits for it. Related records or reservations may prevent deletion.
leaveDescription: You have unsaved changes. Leaving discards this page's drafts. A pending write must finish before you leave.
replacementHint: This replaces the entire amenity collection. Any existing pair omitted here will be removed. An empty list removes all amenities. Record edits are saved separately.
amenitiesInvalid: Use up to 100 pairs. Each name is required (100 characters maximum); each value is required (32 characters maximum).
deliveryHint: Uploads and metadata editing are available. Existing images show placeholders until an approved delivery host and mapping are configured. Stored references are not browser URLs.
fileHint: One JPEG, PNG or WebP image, up to 5 MiB. The server also validates the actual file signature and its configured policy.
fileSize: Choose a nonempty image no larger than 5 MiB.
fileType: Use a .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .webp file with the matching image type and a valid filename.
deleteImageHint: Delete this image and its metadata? This action cannot be undone.
deleteProjectHint: Delete this entire project? This also removes its units, amenities, images and time plan, and discards all drafts on this page. Any reservation prevents deletion. This cannot be undone.
imageRemoved: This image no longer exists in current data. Your text draft is preserved below for copying; image actions are unavailable.
initiativeUnitHint: Required for an initiative unit. Its calculated total must not exceed the project price.
